models.name: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B
models.score_source: ESTIMATE (no AA data): mapped by hand from base model + vendor retention numbers; treat as UNVERIFIED. Basis: PrismML reports 98.2% of Qwen3.8-27B FP16 on a 14-20 benchmark suite (84.78 vs 86.32), but knowledge -5.7 pts and agentic -1.8 pts, which v5 weights heavily -> ~90% of Qwen3.8-27B Xhigh (20.1)

Category deltas vs FP16: math 96.6/97.1, coding 89.4/89.1, IF 82.7/81.3, agentic 74.9/76.7, knowledge 79.9/85.6, vision 66.2/71.4. Speed (llama-bench tg128, PQ2_0 unless noted): RTX 5090 129.9, RTX PRO 60

models.notes: Released 2026-08-25. Dense GQA transformer (GraniteForCausalLM, 40 layers, 40 Q / 8 KV heads, head_dim 64, 3,659,737,600 params), post-trained from Granite-4.1-3B-Base with built-in <think> reasoning (thinking / non-thinking / low-effort modes). 128K native (card: long-context extension to 512K).
